ui.$description: UI font. The owner leaves `ui_font_family` unset, so Zed uses its default `.ZedSans`, which default.json (line 57) says currently aliases to IBM Plex Sans; Zed bundles it. The fallbacks are for a page built from these tokens.

buffer.$description: Editor (buffer) font, set by the owner. Agent-panel user messages and the terminal use the buffer font when theirs is unset.

bufferDefault.$description: Zed's default buffer font, `.ZedMono`, which default.json (line 29) says currently aliases to Lilex. Not used in these captures: the owner sets Menlo.

uiBase.$description: `ui_font_size`: the rem base the UI scales from (the owner's value equals Zed's default of 16). Labels render smaller; see `typography`.

buffer.$description: `buffer_font_size`, set by the owner (Zed's default is 15). The pixels agree: an 8 pt capital (cap.buffer) is 11 pt Menlo.

agentUi.$description: `agent_ui_font_size`, set by the owner. Agent replies measure smaller (cap.agentBody gives about 14), so the panel scales from this base as the UI does.

agentBuffer.$description: `agent_buffer_font_size` default: user messages in the agent panel, in the buffer font.

terminal.$description: Terminal font size as the Settings window shows it (Terminal > Font Size 10.00, marked as changed from the default); read as text off screenshots/dark/36-settings-terminal.png.

semibold.$description: Headings in agent replies and Markdown, judged by stroke width; Zed's theme file sets no UI weights.

buffer.$description: `buffer_line_height` is "standard" (owner), which default.json (line 48) defines as 1.3. The pixels agree: a buffer line is 14pt at 11 pt (size.gutterLine).

bufferComfortable.$description: Zed's default `buffer_line_height` ("comfortable"). Not used in these captures.

label.$description: Default UI label: file tree rows, tabs, menu and palette items, settings row titles, status bar. Size Derived from capital heights (cap.tree 9.5pt, cap.settingsRow 9.5pt, cap.treeL 9.5pt) at IBM Plex Sans's cap height of 0.698 em, plus or minus 1 pt.

labelSmall.$description: Secondary text: settings descriptions, inline hints. Dark reads 8.5 pt, light 9 pt (12 to 13 px). Size Derived from capital heights (cap.settingsDesc 9pt, cap.settingsDesc 8.5pt) at IBM Plex Sans's cap height of 0.698 em, plus or minus 1 pt.

title.$description: Page title in the Settings window ('General'). Size Derived from capital heights (cap.settingsTitle 12pt, cap.settingsTitle 11.5pt) at IBM Plex Sans's cap height of 0.698 em, plus or minus 1 pt.

body.$description: Agent replies and Markdown preview paragraphs. Size Derived from capital heights (cap.agentBody 9.5pt, cap.mdBody 9.5pt) at IBM Plex Sans's cap height of 0.698 em, plus or minus 1 pt.

heading.$description: Headings inside agent replies ('Done', 'Follow-ups'): the body size, heavier. Size Derived from capital heights (cap.agentHeading 9.5pt) at IBM Plex Sans's cap height of 0.698 em, plus or minus 1 pt.

markdownH1.$description: H1 in the Markdown preview. Size Derived from capital heights (cap.mdH1 17pt) at IBM Plex Sans's cap height of 0.698 em, plus or minus 1 pt.

code.$description: The editor, terminal output in tool cards and code in replies: Menlo at the owner's 11 pt; cap.buffer reads 8pt, which is 11 pt at Menlo's measured cap ratio.

sm.$description: Buttons, selects, the settings search field and nav rows: 3.5pt (button), 3.5pt (select), 3.5pt (nav row), dark. Fitted to the corner's outline, plus or minus 0.5 pt.

md.$description: Context menus and the agent's user message box: 5.5pt (menu), 5.625pt (message), dark.

lg.$description: The command palette, pickers and tooltips: 7.5pt (palette), 7.375pt (tooltip), dark. Light readings come out lower (3.25pt, 3.875pt) because the light border barely differs from the surface and the shadow.

full.$description: Switch tracks are pills: a 7.5pt fit on an 18 pt track.

1.$description: Palette border to the selected row's fill (4pt).

2.$description: Window edge to a file-tree icon (8.5pt, icon side bearing included).

3.$description: Padding inside the agent's user message box (12pt) and palette rows (11pt to the first ink).

6.$description: Tab edge to its label (23.5pt): the close-button slot sits on the left (the owner's `tabs.close_position`).

8.$description: Settings sidebar to the page content (32.5pt).

titleBar.$description: Title bar height (project, branch, update button, avatar). Reading `size.titleBar`: 34pt (dark).

toolbar.$description: Breadcrumb toolbar under the tabs. Reading `size.toolbar`: 44pt (dark).

projectPanel.$description: Project panel width: 239pt of fill plus a 1 pt border; the Settings window lists Project Panel Default Width 240 (35-settings-panels).

tab.$description: Width of the 'inventory.py' tab; tabs size to their label. Reading `size.activeTab`: 120pt (dark).

bufferLine.$description: One editor line at Menlo 11 pt, standard line height. Reading `size.gutterLine`: 14pt (dark).

control.$description: Selects, the settings search field and nav rows, border to border (search and nav row read the same). Reading `size.select.h`: 28pt (dark).

button.$description: Small bordered button in the title bar ('Restart to Update'), border to border. Reading `size.button.h`: 24pt (dark).

paletteWidth.$description: Command palette and file finder: 608pt inside a 1 pt border on each side.

paletteRow.$description: Palette and picker rows: the selected row's fill reads 32.5pt.

menuWidth.$description: File context menu, border to border; menus size to their longest item. Reading `size.menu.w`: 212pt (dark).

tooltip.$description: Tooltip height: 35.5pt border to border in dark, 32.5pt in light (the dark shadow reads as border).

width.$description: Switch track, border to border. Reading `size.switch.w`: 32pt (dark).

height.$description: Switch track, border to border. Reading `size.switch.h`: 18pt (dark).

sendButton.$description: Agent composer send button, width (height 22). Reading `size.sendButton`: 24x22pt (dark).

userMessage.$description: A one-line user message box in the agent panel, border to border. Reading `size.userMessage.h`: 42pt (dark).

toolCardHeader.$description: Header of a terminal tool card (label and command). Reading `size.toolCardHeader`: 37.5pt (dark).

settingsSidebar.$description: Settings window sidebar, border excluded. Reading `size.settingsSidebar`: 225pt (dark).

default.$description: Every divider and control border is 2 px in the 2x captures (px.border, px.border.variant).

notTokenised: Shadows: popovers and menus cast a soft shadow (visible below the palette); its blur and offset were not measured
Icon sizes: Zed's icons are its own (Lucide-derived) set and are not kept here
Theme keys declared null in One Dark and One Light (`pane.focused_border`, `panel.focused_border`)
`version_control.conflict_marker.ours` and `.theirs`: declared in One Dark only, so left out of both sets

page.$description: The editor, the largest surface; tabs' active fill and the terminal match it. Alias of theme key `editor.background`.

surface.$description: Panels (project, git, agent), the tab bar and inactive tabs. Alias of theme key `panel.background`.

raised.$description: The command palette, pickers, menus and tooltips. Alias of theme key `elevated_surface.background`.

chrome.$description: Title bar and status bar (`background` and `status_bar.background` are the same value). Alias of theme key `title_bar.background`.

primary.$description: Labels and UI text. Alias of theme key `text`.

secondary.$description: Muted labels: breadcrumbs, descriptions, file-tree folders. Alias of theme key `text.muted`.

placeholder.$description: Placeholders in the palette, composer and search fields. Alias of theme key `text.placeholder`.

disabled.$description: Disabled labels (menu items such as Paste with an empty clipboard). Alias of theme key `text.disabled`.

link.$description: Links in agent replies and the Markdown preview, and accented labels. Alias of theme key `text.accent`.

code.$description: Plain text in the buffer. Alias of theme key `editor.foreground`.

default.$description: Dividers between bars and panels; control borders. Alias of theme key `border`.

subtle.$description: Borders of popovers, menus and the palette; lines inside the editor chrome. Alias of theme key `border.variant`.

focus.$description: The focused element's outline (the Cancel button in the system prompt shows the OS ring, not this). Alias of theme key `border.focused`.

selected.$description: Selected element border. Alias of theme key `border.selected`.

default.$description: The one hue: links, the active status-bar icon, accent icons, the cursor (player 0). Alias of theme key `text.accent`.

hover.$description: Controls on hover: Zed shifts a control's fill to `element.hover`, not an accent shade. Alias of theme key `element.hover`.

pressed.$description: Controls while pressed. Alias of theme key `element.active`.

selected.$description: The selected row in the palette, pickers and lists. Alias of theme key `element.selected`.

default.$description: Filled controls (selects, steppers, the switch track when off). Alias of theme key `element.background`.

ghostHover.$description: Ghost buttons (icon buttons, tabs, list rows) on hover. Alias of theme key `ghost_element.hover`.

switchOn.$description: Switch track when on. No theme key gives this value directly (it is not `text.accent` or `border.focused`); the reading's dominant colour covers 91% of its box.

success.$description: Success text and icons. Alias of theme key `success`.

danger.$description: Errors: diagnostics, squiggles, the error count. Alias of theme key `error`.

successBg.$description: Success fill. Alias of theme key `success.background`.

warningBg.$description: Warning fill (the 'settings are out of date' banner). Alias of theme key `warning.background`.

dangerBg.$description: Error fill (diagnostic blocks). Alias of theme key `error.background`.

infoBg.$description: Information fill. Alias of theme key `info.background`.

added.$description: Gutter bar and diff for added lines. Alias of theme key `version_control.added`.

modified.$description: Gutter bar for modified lines. Alias of theme key `version_control.modified`.

deleted.$description: Gutter marker and diff for deleted lines. Alias of theme key `version_control.deleted`.

match.$description: Search matches in the buffer (translucent). Alias of theme key `search.match_background`.

activeBg.$description: Active tab fill: the editor's colour, so the tab joins the buffer.

text.$description: Inactive tab label (a modified file's label takes `modified`, the owner's `tabs.git_status`).
Tooltip label; the key binding beside it is muted.

bg.$description: Ghost button fill: transparent until hover.
Text fields (settings search, the agent composer) take the editor's colour.
The agent panel's user message box: the editor colour inside a `border`-coloured outline, on the panel surface.
